q1.explanationZh: 第四段说，这次旅行以后，Jack 成了“单车天使”车队的志愿者，所以现在的身份是志愿者。

evidence.quote: I became a volunteer for the Bike Angel team

q2.sampleAnswer: Because he wanted to help children from the orphanage realize their dream of travelling by bicycle.

keyPoints.descZh: 想帮孤儿院的孩子实现骑车旅行的梦想
examples: to help children from the orphanage realize their dream of travelling by bicycle

q2.rubricZh: 要点：帮助孤儿院的孩子实现骑自行车旅行的梦想。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说，杨先生去孤儿院，发现很多孩子爱骑车却没钱买车，所以决定帮他们实现骑车旅行的梦想，就组建了车队。

evidence.quote: Mr. Yang decided to help us realize our dream of travelling by bicycle.

q3.sampleAnswer: It helped them find hope and work hard for a better life.

keyPoints.descZh: 让他们努力工作，创造更好的生活
examples: work hard for a better life
started working hard to create a better life

q3.rubricZh: 要点：找到希望；努力创造更好的生活。
q3.explanationZh: 第四段说，多亏了这些骑行旅行，很多年轻人找到了希望，并且开始努力工作，为自己创造更好的生活。回答要写出这两点。

evidence.quote: many of them found hope and started working hard to create a better life for themselves

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I once took part in a hiking trip. I learned that I can overcome difficulties with hard work and a willing heart. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 说出一次有挑战的经历，并写出从中学到了什么（合理即可）
examples: Yes, I once took part in a hiking trip. I learned that I can overcome difficulties with hard work.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题：只要内容合理，说出一次有挑战的活动和自己的收获即可。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题，没有唯一答案。先回答有没有参加过有挑战的活动，再说说你从中学到了什么，比如坚持和努力能克服困难。

evidence.quote: help young people see the wider world and challenge themselves
